project_name: Premium Enterprise ERP Batch Management Dashboard Redesign
design_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast / Premium Enterprise SaaS ERP

grid_system.kpi_row: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3 sm:gap-4
grid_system.financial_row: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 sm:gap-4
grid_system.analytics_area: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 sm:gap-5

cards.wrapper: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-md hover:border-slate-300

page_header.container: flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-slate-200
page_header.breadcrumb: flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto py-1 text-xs text-slate-600
page_header.breadcrumb_step: flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-medium hover:bg-slate-200 cursor-pointer transition-colors
page_header.quick_actions_button: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg bg-blue-900 text-white hover:bg-blue-800 transition-colors shadow-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2

kpi_card.container: relative overflow-hidden bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 p-4 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 group flex flex-col justify-between
kpi_card.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500
kpi_card.icon_container: p-2 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-transform group-hover:scale-105

financial_kpi_card.container: bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 to-slate-800 text-white rounded-xl p-4 border border-slate-800 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-slate-700 transition-all
financial_kpi_card.label: text-xs font-medium text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider
financial_kpi_card.subtext: text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2 flex items-center gap-1

filter_bar.container: bg-white p-3 sm:p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-sm flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3
filter_bar.select_box: h-9 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 focus:bg-white focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 transition-colors px-3
filter_bar.clear_btn: h-9 px-3 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg transition-colors border border-slate-200
filter_bar.export_btn: h-9 px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-700 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 hover:bg-blue-100 rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5

tables.container: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-sm overflow-hidden
tables.header_row: bg-slate-50/80 border-b border-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider sticky top-0 z-10 backdrop-blur-sm
tables.row: border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-blue-50/30 transition-colors text-xs text-slate-800 group
tables.view_btn: px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-blue-700 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 rounded transition-colors
tables.edit_btn: px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded transition-colors

slide_over_drawer.overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 transition-opacity
slide_over_drawer.panel: fixed inset-y-0 right-0 max-w-xl w-full bg-white shadow-2xl z-50 flex flex-col border-l border-slate-200 transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out
slide_over_drawer.header: px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-between
slide_over_drawer.footer: px-6 py-4 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-end gap-2

lifecycle_stepper.container: bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-sm space-y-4
lifecycle_stepper.step_item: flex-1 flex flex-col items-center cursor-pointer group text-center px-2 py-1 rounded-lg transition-colors hover:bg-slate-50
lifecycle_stepper.step_circle_complete: w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs border border-emerald-300
lifecycle_stepper.step_circle_active: w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-blue-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs ring-4 ring-blue-100 shadow-sm
lifecycle_stepper.step_circle_pending: w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs border border-slate-200

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow design specs and colors specified in this JSON.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select items, tabs, menu items, table rows) have unique `data-testid` attributes.
Do not break existing React states, filters, API mappings, calculations, or permissions.
Preserve existing left sidebar and top navigation intact while updating main content area.
Ensure the slide-over drawer opens seamlessly on clicking 'View' in the Work Order Financial Summary table.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark background gradients; stick to clean off-white / slate surfaces with crisp borders.
Add transition utilities to specific interactive elements (e.g. `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`) and avoid universal `transition-all` on root layout containers.
All cards must have rounded corners (`rounded-xl`), thin border (`border-slate-200/80`), and light shadow (`shadow-sm`).
Use JetBrains Mono or standard font formatting for financial metrics and currency values (e.g., ₹ Values).
